title: 第2章  死人没必要知道
content_zh:
“今天才刚发放的凝气丹和下品灵石，自己主动交出来，免得受皮肉之苦！”
言语间，一道高有六尺，体型臃肿，肥头大耳的男子走了进来，脸上满是戏谑之色。
谁能想到，他身为杂役弟子，有朝一日能够骑在内门弟子第一人的头上拉屎。
这放在以前，简直是想都不敢想的事情！
“张霖！”
“老子还没去找你，你竟然还敢来找我！”
苏烬生见到来人之后，心中顿时升起熊熊烈火，咬牙切齿出声。
这些年来，欺辱他次数最多的，便是眼前这张霖。
每个月发放的凝气丹和下品灵石在他手中不会超过半天时间，就会被张霖抢去。
自己若是不交，便会迎来一顿毒打！
有一次，更是被打断了左腿，用了几个月时间才恢复如初！
他感觉，若不是自己每个月可以领到修炼资源的话，可能已经被他们埋尸荒野了！
张霖闻言微微一愣，显然没想到这个废物竟然敢这样跟他说话。
但也并未放在心上，因为在他看来，这只是苏烬生的无能狂怒罢了，满脸不屑出声。
“本来老子今天心情好，不想出手的，但是没办法，这是你自找的！”
说完之后，嘴角便翘起一抹邪魅的弧度，摩拳擦掌的走上前去。
显然，他十分乐意出手教训一下，这个曾经的内门弟子第一人！
“也罢，复仇之路，便从你开始！”
苏烬生双眸绽放寒光，面露杀意，言语冰冷出声的瞬间，体内灵气迸发，手掌紧握成拳，猛然砸了出去！
“砰！！”

拳头结结实实砸在张霖胸口上，发出一道沉闷声响，回荡在山洞之中。
张霖臃肿的身躯直接倒退数步，随即一个踉跄跌倒在地上，只感觉胸前一阵涌动。
“噗！”
一口鲜血喷吐而出！
他没有想到，以前只知道护住身体的苏烬生竟然也会发动进攻。
并且，还成功将他击伤！
这让他怒火中烧，双目瞪得溜圆，仿佛受到了莫大的屈辱一般，厉喝出声。
“你竟然还敢动手！”
“今日我若是不将你打死在这里，我就不姓张！！”
随即，立即起身，炼气三重境气势从身上爆发而出，挥动双拳便冲了过去。
拳势凶猛，好似猛虎下山一般，势如破竹！
“虎啸拳！”
“这也配叫虎啸拳？我看是猫啸拳差不多！”
苏烬生眼中满是不屑，轻蔑出声。
“今日就让你看看，什么是真正的虎啸拳！”
说罢，体内灵气汇聚双拳，一股霸道气息散发而出。
紧接着，双拳挥动，攻势迅猛，耳边似有虎啸之声传来一般，霸道至极！
“砰！”
“咔嚓！”
沉闷的声音刚刚响起，便被骨头碎裂的声音压了下去。

张霖衣袖瞬间被震碎，整条手臂崩裂一般，涌现出丝丝鲜血。
身子倒退数步之后，便直接摔倒在了地面上，捂着受伤的手臂，蜷缩成了一团。
这虎啸拳乃是凡阶中品武技，他早在当初刚加入宗门之时便已修炼。
至今已然有六年时间，早已炉火纯青，熟练无比！
所以张霖在他面前施展这一门武技，简直就是自寻死路！
苏烬生望着那道狼狈的身影，心中顿感解气。
踏马的，被欺辱这么长时间，终于能报仇了！
“你，你突破至炼气二重境界了！”
地面上，张霖牙关紧咬，面色狰狞，瞪大双眼中布满血丝，言语中满是不可思议的神色。
虽然他乃是练气三重境武者，但是苏烬生将他击败，只需达到炼气二重境武者即可。
因为苏烬生的实战经验丰富，且体质力量远超炼气境，非常人所能够相比的，故而可越境界战斗。
“一个死人，没必要知道这么多！”
苏烬生声音冰冷，蕴含杀意，灵气包裹双拳，迈步走上前去。
“不，不要！”
“不要杀我！”
张霖被浓重的杀意包裹，整个人如坠冰窟一般，打了个寒颤，恐惧瞬间笼罩心头。
顾不得断骨之痛，挣扎着身子便朝着后面退去，在他看来。
此刻的苏烬生宛若一头杀人恶魔一般，无半点人性！
“不杀你？”
“不杀你我这些年来所受的屈辱算什么？”

苏烬生看张霖宛若看一个死人一般，低沉出声。
“我来时，见于彦君前去林月舒的住处了，不知道他会做出什么出格的事情！”
“你还是抓紧回去吧！”
什么！？
于彦君这个狗日的！真是找死！！
苏烬生瞳孔猛地一缩，心中怒气更盛，杀意也更加浓郁。
拳头猛然挥出，虎啸拳再度施展，直冲面门！
“砰！！”
张霖整个脑袋直接炸开，鲜血四溅，身子直挺挺的倒在了地上，成为了无头之尸。
原本他想将此事说出，保全性命，谁曾想，却加快了死亡！
苏烬生没有半点犹豫，身影飞速的朝着外面冲去，心中则是怒吼出声。
于彦君，你若敢动林月舒半个手指头，老子今天让你生不如死！
当初他初入宗门之时，与林月舒同为杂役弟子，二人相互帮衬，有几分交情。
后来，他地位日益增高，实力也越来越强，二人来往就很少了。
基本都是他去探望林月舒，而林月舒却很少麻烦他。
一年前跌落神坛，全宗上下皆为嘲讽，唯有林月舒鼓励他。
甚至，还拿出自己的凝气丹以及下品灵石供他吞噬。
可以说，这一年若是没有林月舒的话，他可能就是一具浑浑噩噩的行尸走肉！
只是，因为二人走的太近，林月舒也时常护他，逐渐，林月舒也成为了被欺辱的对象。
时常也会被抢夺去凝气丹以及下品灵石！

但林月舒从未怪罪过他！
如今，他的境界已经开始恢复，将不允许任何人再欺辱林月舒半分！
快点，再快点！
苏烬生面带怒意，体内灵气疯狂催动，速度飞快的朝着杂役弟子住处赶去，心中着急出声。
此刻，林月舒的住处，已然围观着诸多杂役弟子，一个个如看戏般站在原地。
“小贱人，那个苏烬生已经成为废物了，凝气丹给他也是浪费，不如给我吧！”
于彦君身材消瘦，皮肤黝黑，脸上露出一个邪恶的笑容，开口出声。
对立面，林月舒一身杂役弟子服饰，不施任何水粉胭脂，却难掩美色。
她眉清目秀，琼鼻，皓齿红唇，常年的杂活并未让她皮肤粗糙。
反而白皙如玉，柔弱无骨一般，极为诱人！
“凭什么给你，你又是什么东西？”
林月舒心中怒火汹涌，言语凌厉，直接厉喝出声！
“赶紧给我滚出去，否则的话，我就要上告杂役总管！”
杂役总管就是负责给所有杂役弟子分配杂活，平时也负责监管杂役弟子。
“你这脾气还是这般火爆，真是让人喜欢啊！”
于彦君并未发怒，反而脸上露出一个邪魅的笑意，出声道。
“不如你就跟在我身边，当个小妾，我保证，绝对不会有人再上门找你的麻烦！”
林月舒心中怒意更盛，美目中似乎能喷出烈焰一般，反驳出声！
“呸！”
“就凭你，也不撒泡尿照照自己配吗？”

此言似乎戳中了于彦军的痛处，面色瞬间阴沉了下来。
因为，他的相貌的确丑陋，平时众人都碍于他的威言，并不敢当面说出。
“哼！”
“真是找死！”
于彦君冷哼一声之后，一步迈上前去，伸手便打了过去。
“啪！”
一个清脆响亮的巴掌声响起，引得身后诸多杂役弟子一阵嘲笑。
林月舒顿感一阵天旋地转，直接瘫坐在了地上，脸上多出了一个巴掌红印。
她只有炼气一重境，而于彦君却是炼气三重境，实力差距极大，根本无半点反抗之力！
“真是敬酒不吃从罚酒！”
于彦军脸上怒意消散几分，伸手抓住林月舒的头发，一脸邪恶的道。
“不交凝气丹和下品灵石也行，那就陪我一晚如何？”
“滚开！”
“都给我滚开！”
苏烬生的怒喝之声从远处传来，引得众人纷纷回首！
content_en:
"Hand over the Qi Condensation Pills and low-grade spirit stones that were just distributed today, so that you don't suffer any physical pain!"
While he was talking, a six-foot-tall man with a bloated body and fat head and big ears walked in, his face full of teasing.
Who would have thought that as a handyman disciple, he would one day be able to sit on the head of the number one inner disciple and shit.
This was something that was simply unthinkable before!
"Zhang Lin!"
"I haven't come to find you yet, but you still dare to come to me!"
After Su Jinsheng saw the visitor, a blazing fire suddenly arose in his heart, and he gritted his teeth.
Over the years, the one who had bullied him the most was Lin in front of him.
The Qi Condensing Pills and low-grade spiritual stones distributed every month would not be in his hands for more than half a day before they would be snatched away by Zhang Lin.
If you don't pay, you will be beaten severely!
Once, my left leg was even broken, and it took several months to recover!
He felt that if he hadn't received the training resources every month, he might have been buried in the wilderness by them!
Zhang Lin was slightly stunned when he heard this, obviously he didn't expect that this loser would dare to talk to him like this.
But he didn't take it to heart, because in his opinion, this was just Su Jinsheng's incompetent rage, and he was disdainful to speak out.
"Originally, I was in a good mood today and didn't want to take action, but I couldn't help it. You asked for it!"
After finishing speaking, the corners of his mouth turned up with a sinister arc, and he stepped forward eagerly.
Obviously, he was very willing to teach this former number one inner disciple a lesson!
"Forget it, the road to revenge begins with you!"
Su Jinsheng's eyes flashed with cold light, his face showed murderous intent, and the moment he spoke cold words, the spiritual energy in his body burst out, and he clenched his hands into fists and slammed them out!
"Bang!!"
The fist hit Zhang Lin firmly on the chest, making a dull sound that echoed in the cave.
Zhang Lin's bloated body took a few steps back, then stumbled and fell to the ground, feeling a surge in his chest.
"Poof!"
A mouthful of blood spurted out!
He did not expect that Su Jinsheng, who only knew how to protect his body before, would also launch an attack.
Moreover, he successfully injured him!
This made him furious, his eyes widened, as if he had been greatly humiliated, and he shouted loudly.
"How dare you do it!"
"If I don't beat you to death here today, my surname will not be Zhang!!"
Immediately, he stood up, the aura of the third level of Qi Refining burst out from his body, and he rushed over with his fists waving.
The punch is fierce, like a tiger descending from the mountain, and the momentum is as strong as breaking a bamboo!
"Tiger Roaring Fist!"
"Does this deserve to be called Tiger Roaring Fist? I think it's almost like Cat's Roaring Fist!"
Su Jinsheng's eyes were full of disdain and he spoke with contempt.
"Today I will show you what the real Tiger Roaring Fist is!"
After saying that, the spiritual energy in his body gathered into his fists, and a domineering aura came out.
Immediately afterwards, he waved his fists and attacked rapidly, as if there was a roar of a tiger in his ears, extremely domineering!
"Bang!"
"Crack!"
The dull sound just sounded, and was suppressed by the sound of broken bones.
Zhang Lin's sleeves were instantly shattered, and his entire arm seemed to burst, with traces of blood pouring out.
After taking a few steps back, he fell directly to the ground, clutching his injured arm and curling up into a ball.
This Tiger Roaring Fist is a mid-level mortal martial arts skill that he had practiced as early as when he first joined the sect.
It has been six years now, and I have become extremely proficient and proficient!
Therefore, if Zhang Lin used this martial art in front of him, he would be seeking death!
Su Jinsheng looked at the embarrassed figure and felt relieved.
The horse-riding man, who has been bullied for so long, can finally take revenge!
"You, you have broken through to the second level of Qi refining!"
On the ground, Zhang Lin clenched his teeth, his face was ferocious, his eyes were wide and bloodshot, and his words were full of incredulity.
AlthoughHe was a warrior at the third level of Qi training, but Su Jinsheng only needed to reach the second level of Qi refining to defeat him.
Because Su Jinsheng has rich experience in actual combat, and his physical strength far exceeds that of the Qi Refining realm, which is unmatched by others, he can fight across realms.
"A dead man doesn't need to know so much!"
Su Jinsheng's voice was cold and contained murderous intent. His aura wrapped his fists and he stepped forward.
"No, don't!"
"Don't kill me!"
Zhang Lin was wrapped in a strong murderous intention, and his whole body felt as if he had fallen into an ice cave. He shuddered, and fear instantly enveloped his heart.
Ignoring the pain of broken bones, he struggled and retreated back. In his opinion.
At this moment, Su Jinsheng was like a murderous demon, without any humanity at all!
"Won't I kill you?"
"If I don't kill you, what will the humiliation I have endured over the years count?"
Su Jinsheng looked at Zhang Lin as if he were a dead person and spoke in a low voice.
"When I came, I saw Yu Yanjun going to Lin Yueshu's residence. I wonder what outrageous things he would do!"
"You'd better go back quickly!"
What! ?
Yu Yanjun is such a bitch! Really looking for death! !
Su Jinsheng's pupils shrank suddenly, the anger in his heart became stronger, and his murderous intention became more intense.
The fist was suddenly swung out, and the Tiger Roaring Fist was used again, heading straight towards the door!
"Bang!!"
Zhang Lin's whole head exploded directly, blood spattered everywhere, and his body fell straight to the ground, becoming a headless corpse.
Originally, he wanted to tell the story to save his life, but who would have thought that he would hasten his death!
Su Jinsheng didn't hesitate at all, and rushed outside quickly, roaring in his heart.
Yu Yanjun, if you dare to touch even a finger of Lin Yueshu, I will make your life worse than death today!
When he first entered the sect, he and Lin Yueshu were both servant disciples. The two helped each other and had a certain friendship.
Later, as his status increased and his strength became stronger, the two of them had little contact.
Basically, he went to visit Lin Yueshu, but Lin Yueshu rarely bothered him.
He fell from the altar a year ago and was ridiculed by everyone in the sect. Only Lin Yueshu encouraged him.
He even took out his Qi Condensing Pill and low-grade spiritual stones for him to devour.
It can be said that if it had not been for Lin Yueshu this year, he might have been a walking corpse!
However, because the two were too close, Lin Yueshu often protected him. Gradually, Lin Yueshu also became the target of bullying.
They are often robbed of Qi Condensing Pills and low-grade spiritual stones!
But Lin Yueshu never blamed him!
Now, his realm has begun to recover, and he will not allow anyone to bully Lin Yueshu any more!
Hurry up, hurry up!
Su Jinsheng had an angry look on his face, and the spiritual energy in his body was arousing crazily. He rushed towards the residence of the handyman disciples at a very fast speed, speaking anxiously in his heart.
At this moment, Lin Yueshu's residence was already crowded with many handyman disciples, all standing there as if they were watching a play.
"Little bitch, that Su Jinsheng has become a waste. Giving him the Qi Condensing Pill is a waste, why not give it to me!"
Yu Yanjun was thin and dark-skinned, with an evil smile on his face as he spoke.
On the opposite side, Lin Yueshu was dressed in the uniform of a handyman disciple, without applying any gouache or rouge, but her beauty could not be concealed.
She has pretty features, a beautiful nose, white teeth, and red lips. Years of chores have not made her skin rough.
On the contrary, she is as white as jade, as soft and boneless, and extremely attractive!
"Why should I give it to you? Who are you?"
Lin Yueshu's heart was filled with anger, her words were sharp, and she shouted loudly!
"Get out of here right away, otherwise, I'm going to report it to the head janitor!"
The head chore manager is responsible for assigning chores to all the handyman disciples, and is also responsible for supervising the handyman disciples.
"You still have such a hot temper, I really like it!"
Yu Yanjun did not get angry, but instead said with a devilish smile on his face.
"Why don't you just stay with me and be a concubine? I promise,No one will ever come to trouble you again! "
Lin Yueshu's heart became even more angry, her beautiful eyes seemed to be able to emit flames, and she retorted!
“Bah! "
"Isn't it worthy of you that you don't just urinate and look after yourself? "
These words seemed to hit a sore spot in Yu Yanjun's face, and his expression instantly darkened.
Because his appearance is indeed ugly, and usually everyone is afraid of saying it to his face because of his authority.
"Hmph! "
“You’re really looking for death! "
Yu Yanjun snorted coldly, stepped forward, reached out and hit him.
"Crack! "
A loud and clear slap sounded, causing many disciples behind him to laugh.
Lin Yueshu felt dizzy and collapsed on the ground, with a red mark from a slap on his face.
She is only in the first level of Qi refining, but Yu Yanjun is in the third level of Qi refining. The difference in strength is huge, and there is no power to resist at all!
"It's true that if you don't eat the toast, you'll be punished by drinking! "
The anger on Yu Yanjun's face dissipated a little, and he reached out to grab Lin Yueshu's hair and said with an evil look on his face.
“It’s okay if you don’t hand over the Qi Condensation Pill and the low-grade spirit stone, then how about you stay with me for one night? "
"Get away! "
"Get out of here! "
Su Jinsheng's angry shouts came from a distance, causing everyone to look back!
